appearance: Burgell Ningel is a small, compact Rock Gnome Gnome paladin with a weathered look that speaks of many roads traveled.
backstory: After years as a soldier, Burgell heard the call to adventure. Armed with paladin training and hard-won wisdom, the journey begins.
